name: NFL Draft
author: ChuckBuilds
description: Displays projected NFL draft picks from ESPN with live draft tracking support during the annual NFL Draft event. Includes simulate_live mode to replay a completed draft using real ESPN core API data. Shows team logos, player names, positions, and pick numbers in a scrolling display.

versions.notes: live_refresh_interval is honoured. Core runs update() on the manifest's update_interval (300 seconds) unless the plugin asks otherwise, so a live refresh interval under 300 (the setting allows 60) never happened on draft day. The plugin now implements get_update_interval(), the LEDMatrix core 3.4.0 hook: while the draft is live or in its date window, core calls update() every live_refresh_interval; otherwise it keeps the 300-second tick, and projection_refresh_interval still spaces out the fetches. The plugin also loads when LEDMatrix's hardware init failed: it read display_manager.matrix.width, and matrix is None then; it now reads display_manager.width and height. Requires LEDMatrix core 3.4.0, as before.

Requires LEDMatrix core 3.4.0. scroll_speed (pixels per second) now sets the scroll speed: the shared resolver was handed the root config, where it looks for a scroll_speed + scroll_delay pair this plugin never declared, so every user got its 100 px/s default instead of the documented 30. The speed is passed as pixels per second and snapped to the nearest speed the panel can move in whole pixels (30 becomes 33.3 px/s on a 100 Hz panel). Default speed change: installs at the default 30 now scroll at 33.3 px/s, a third of the 100 px/s they actually ran at; set scroll_speed to 100 for the old speed. The frame hold that snap needs is now applied while scrolling (set_scrolling_state(True, frame_hold=...), a 3.4.0 argument, hence the floor) and released when the scroll completes or nothing is drawn. Removed the legacy set_scroll_speed/set_scroll_delay setup and the target_fps writes after the resolver, which nothing read. The auto-detected draft_year is re-resolved on every update, so a Pi left running since last year's draft recognises this year's draft days instead of polling daily at the old year. vegas_mode is unchanged: core reads it (BasePlugin.get_vegas_display_mode).

Remove the transition.* block: three settings in the schema and the web UI that neither this plugin nor the core reads, and the core implements no display transitions (#381). A config.json still carrying them fails validation until it is saved again, hence the major.
Validation-sweep fixes; see the PR for the specific defect.

versions.changelog: Resolve scroll speed through the shared resolver and apply the frame hold it reports, so slow speeds move whole pixels
Render text 1-bit (no anti-aliasing) so glyphs stay crisp on the LED grid

versions.notes: Documentation. The configuration table covered 21 of the 33 settings; the twelve it missed include the three that decide what the panel shows once the draft is over (post_draft_show, post_draft_days, display_rounds), the dynamic-duration block and vegas_mode. All 33 are now documented, with transition.type, .speed and .enabled marked as read by nothing (#381). Adds real rendered screenshots of a pick card, the show_position and show_college toggles, two of the offered fonts, and four panel sizes.

Rebuild the scroll image when something else clears its cache. display() drew straight from the ScrollHelper, whose cache Vegas invalidates whenever the plugin reports an update, so a frame could be skipped while picks were loaded. The silent-mode early returns in _create_draft_scroll_image are preserved, so suppressed frames stay suppressed.

Fix ESPN 403s. Around 2026-08-04 ESPN's site.api began rejecting both browser-style and bare custom User-Agent strings, which returned 403 Forbidden for every request this plugin made. Requests now send an identifying agent with the project URL, which ESPN accepts. No behaviour change beyond the header.

Config schema reorganized for a clearer setup experience: fine-tuning fields moved behind the web UI's collapsed Advanced Settings section (x-advanced). UX-only; no fields, defaults, or behavior changed.
Add a GPL-3.0 LICENSE file (project-standard license).
